newsitem.title: DUBAI: Emirates airline introduces cargo fuel surcharge.
newsitem.headline: Emirates airline introduces cargo fuel surcharge.

text.p: Dubai's Emirates airline is phasing in a jet fuel surcharge on cargo shipments on all routes, cargo revenue optimisation manager Pradeep Kumar said on Tuesday.
"In an effort to compensate for the cost escalation because of fuel price increases since July, Emirates, like other carriers, is introducing a fuel surcharge on a worldwide basis," he told Reuters.
Facing high jet fuel prices, a host of international carriers have recently introduced a freight fuel surcharge.
Kumar said the increase of 10 U.S. cents a kg on long-haul and five cents on some shorter-haul flights was being phased in between November 1 and 20.

The surcharge was introduced in most European centres from November 1. It would take effect in most Middle East stations and Singapore on November 15, followed by Hong Kong around November 18, he said.
